brief:
Israeli authorities demolished a residential building in the At Tur area of East Jerusalem on Tuesday, displacing 69 Palestinians, more than half of them children, the UN aid coordination office reported. The structure was destroyed after Israeli authorities approved the demolition.

The displacement adds to a pattern of building demolitions in occupied East Jerusalem, where Palestinian residents face restrictions on construction that Israeli settlers do not.
dek: Sixty-nine Palestinians – more than half of them children – were displaced on Tuesday after Israeli authorities green lit the demolition of their residential building in the At Tur area of East Jerusalem, the UN aid coordination office (OCHA) has reported.
title: Israeli demolition displaces 69 Palestinians in East Jerusalem
